Lesser Healing Potion.flavor: The potion glows faintly as you drink it. Warmth spreads through your body.

Healing Potion.flavor: A rush of energy flows through you as the potion takes effect.

Health Potion.flavor: The bitter liquid works quickly, mending your wounds.

Healing Salve.flavor: You apply the herbal salve. It stings at first, then soothes.

Berry Tonic.flavor: Sweet and refreshing! The berry tonic revitalizes you.

Antitoxin.flavor: The antitoxin burns going down, but you feel the poison neutralizing.

Berry Antidote.flavor: The sweet antidote cleanses your system and restores some vitality.

Potion of Minor Healing.flavor: A soft rosy glow and a warm taste of cinnamon. Elowen's handiwork.

Elixir of Focus.flavor: Your mind clears like fog lifting from a valley. Every thought is crisp and sharp.

Potion of Invisibility (Short).flavor: You watch your hands fade from view... then your arms... then everything. Quite unsettling, actually.

Greater Healing Potion.flavor: The potion blazes with healing light as it restores your strength. Victor's ranger contacts know their craft.

Hearty Stew.description: Restores 20 HP, +1 to all rolls for 1 hour
Hearty Stew.flavor: The warm stew fills your belly and lifts your spirits.

Hearty Rabbit Stew.description: Restores 15 HP, +1 to all rolls for 1 hour
Hearty Rabbit Stew.flavor: Rich and savory! The rabbit stew warms you from the inside.

Roasted Chicken.flavor: Perfectly roasted! The tender meat restores your strength.

Shepherd's Pie.flavor: Comfort food at its finest. You feel reinvigorated.

Fish and Chips.flavor: Crispy and delicious! A satisfying meal.

Full Breakfast.description: Restores 15 HP, +2 to gathering for 2 hours
Full Breakfast.flavor: A hearty breakfast to start the day right!

Venison Roast.flavor: The rich venison fills you with vigor and strength.

Apple Pie.flavor: Sweet and warm! The pie lifts your spirits.

Apple Tart.flavor: A delightful treat that refreshes you.

Meat Pie.flavor: Savory and filling! Just what you needed.

Bread and Cheese.flavor: Simple but satisfying. A classic combination.

Honeycakes.flavor: Sweet honey drips down as you enjoy the treat.

Bowl of Soup.flavor: The warm soup soothes and comforts you.

Mushroom Soup.description: Restores 10 HP, +1 to gathering for 1 hour
Mushroom Soup.flavor: Earthy and delicious! You feel attuned to the forest.

Dried Meat.flavor: Tough but nourishing. Trail food at its finest.

Dried Venison.flavor: The preserved venison restores some energy.

Trail Rations.flavor: Not gourmet, but it keeps you going.

Dried Fruit and Nuts.flavor: A light snack that takes the edge off your hunger.

Roasted Boar.flavor: A feast fit for a warrior! You feel incredibly powerful.

Standard Ale.flavor: Ahh, refreshing! The ale loosens you up.

Bran's House Ale.flavor: Smooth and rich! Bran's finest work.

Dark Ale.flavor: Bold and strong! Liquid courage indeed.

Apple Cider.flavor: Sweet and crisp! The natural sweetness makes animals trust you more.

Mulled Wine.description: Restores 5 HP, resistance to cold for 1 hour
Mulled Wine.flavor: Warm spices fill your senses. The chill melts away.

Fine Wine.flavor: Exquisite! You feel sophisticated and charming.

Milk.flavor: Fresh and wholesome. Simple but good.

Water.flavor: Clean and refreshing. Essential for survival.

Stamina Tonic.description: Reduces all cooldowns by 50% for 30 min
Stamina Tonic.flavor: Energy surges through you! You feel ready for anything.

Forest Brew.flavor: The magical brew heightens your senses to the forest.

Tracking Map.description: +3 to tracking and hunting rolls for 1 hour
Tracking Map.flavor: Victor's hand-drawn map marks trails, dens, and animal signs. Your prey won't escape.

Healing Herbs.flavor: You apply the fresh herbs to your wounds. The natural remedy eases the pain.

Lucky Coin.description: Reroll one failed roll (3 uses, lasts 1 hour)
Lucky Coin.flavor: The coin glints mysteriously. Fortune favors you today.

Bundle of Torches.description: Provides light in dark areas (5 uses)
Bundle of Torches.flavor: You light a torch. Shadows flee from its warm glow.

Sparkbeam Scroll.flavor: You read the fey incantation aloud. Starlight gathers around your weapon, ready to strike!

Fey Blessing.description: +2 gathering bonus and chance for rare fey items (once per day)
Fey Blessing.flavor: You invoke the fey blessing. Nature shimmers around you, eager to share its bounty.

Animal Treats.flavor: You pull out some tasty treats. Nearby animals perk up with interest...

Beast Whistle.description: +5 to your next taming attempt (5 min)
Beast Whistle.flavor: You blow the whistle. It makes no sound you can hear, but animals seem drawn to you.

Calming Incense.description: +4 to taming rolls for 15 min - soothes wild creatures
Calming Incense.flavor: Sweet smoke curls through the air. Wild creatures seem less skittish, more curious.

Beastmaster's Charm.flavor: The charm glows warmly. You feel a deep connection to the natural world.

Raw Meat.flavor: You hold out the raw meat. Predators eye you with hungry interest...

Honey Cake.description: +3 to taming bears and small critters for 10 min
Honey Cake.flavor: The sweet scent of honey wafts through the air. Something rustles nearby...

Shiny Trinket.description: +4 to taming ravens and magpies for 10 min
Shiny Trinket.flavor: You hold up the glittering bauble. Corvids are notoriously attracted to shiny things...

Catnip Pouch.description: +5 to taming cats and felines for 15 min
Catnip Pouch.flavor: You open the pouch. The intoxicating scent drives cats absolutely wild!

Wolf Bane Antidote.description: +4 to taming wolves - masks your scent as non-threatening
Wolf Bane Antidote.flavor: You apply the mixture. Your scent changes subtly - wolves no longer see you as prey or rival.

Whiskey.description: +2 to courage for 30 min, -1 to precision
Whiskey.flavor: Burns going down! You feel bold and fearless.

Sarsaparilla.flavor: Sweet and fizzy! A refreshing frontier drink.

Beef Jerky.flavor: Tough and chewy, but it keeps you going on the trail.

Hardtack.flavor: Hard as a rock, but it fills the belly.

Snake Oil.flavor: You swallow the sharp, herbal mix. Somehow it works.

Stim Pack.flavor: The stim pack hisses as it injects. Instant relief.

Energy Bar.flavor: Compact nutrition. Tastes like cardboard, works like magic.

Synth-Coffee.flavor: Not quite like the real thing, but it sharpens your mind.

Nano-Med.flavor: Millions of tiny machines go to work repairing your body.

Healing Spray.flavor: The fine mist seals wounds and calms the pain.

Nano-Med Gel.flavor: The gel hums softly as it knits tissue back together.
